min_assurance.description: HA-07: the weakest decider proof (approval-assurance.ts) a human-only request created by this rule accepts. A human-only request never goes below A2; dual_key_confirmation always requires A3.

separation_of_duties.description: When enabled, an approving decision whose decider identity equals the request's requester identity is refused with [POLICY_VIOLATION] and audited. Default off.

assurance_mode.description: HA-08: human-approval assurance rollout. warn accepts a human-only decision below its min_assurance and records assurance_shortfall (audit + operator alert); enforce rejects it. KYBERION_APPROVAL_ASSURANCE may tighten this to enforce but never relax it. Agent-path refusal (HA-02) is enforced in every mode.

passkey_enrollment_cooldown_hours.description: HA-07: hours (at least 1) before a member's first passkey (or one enrolled without a step-up from a usable passkey) can settle an A3 decision. Limits what a stolen session can do by enrolling its own passkey; register and revoke always notify the operator. Default 24.
